title: Karn Reclaims the Mirari
summary: Karn retrieves the probe and transforms it into Memnarch, connecting the Otarian crisis to the future of Mirrodin.
narrative: Karn returned to collect the Mirari, an object originally intended to observe the world rather than amplify the ambitions of its inhabitants.
On his artificial plane Argentum, he reshaped the device into Memnarch. That new guardian's subsequent history would become central to the Mirrodin storyline.
